name: Observed PipelineRun State Model

transitions.guard: state is RunState type + DB row exists
transitions.action: persist state and emit EventLog FSM_TRANSITION

invalid_transition_behavior: Observed function does not itself validate previous→next transition topology; it writes any RunState supplied by caller.
recovery_semantics: Failure recording forces runState=FREEZE; recovery behavior is handled elsewhere.
audit_event_semantics: setPipelineRunState writes EventLog FSM_TRANSITION transactionally with PipelineRun update.
alignment_notes: Do not merge this state model with source Queue Job FSM or DOC-C global execution FSM.
